notes.title: Update / Patch 1.1 is available!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone : ) , as announced in the previous news we have just released the Update/Patch 1.1 following those changes:

[b]NEW MONSTER BEHAVIOUR:[/b]

- The Monster is now able to jump and go up on the top of the two cars presents in the level : )

[b]LOADING LAST CHECKPOINT CHANGE:[/b]

- We have implemented a much faster function to reload the last checkpoint once the player die directly from the game without exiting back to main menu.

[b]ISSUES RESOLVED:[/b]

- The saving system could potentially save sometimes when the player is near the monster, this could be a problem since the player will need to escape instantly when load again into the level, we have added some more extra range for the safe zone in wich the saving system is exluded to avoid this
problem.


- Fixed an issue where sometimes the background soundtrack could be playing overlapping

- Fixed the out of stamina breath bug that could keep playing also when you exit to main menu.

- Fixed a bug that could make the player stuck without moving at spawnpoint once created a new game after exiting from a previous run.

Thank you ːlunar2019smilingpigː

- Room 54 dev team.

notes.title: What's coming in next update/hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi! We are working on the next patch/update wich is planned to be release on 03 June : )

In this update we will tweak/fix different things for example:

- The saving system could potentially save sometimes when the player is near the monster, this could be 
   a problem since the player will need to escape instantly when load again into the level, some more 
   extra range for the safe zone will be implemented in wich the saving system is exluded to avoid this 
   problem.

- When the monster is near the player it could be hard to listen his footsteps along with all others 
   sounds , this can make it difficult to perceive wheter the monster is near or not , this is part of the 
   challenge but we want to give you a bit more of forewarning, so we are planning to some 
   recognizable audios that can help in giving a "sort of" danger feel.

- Sometimes the background soundtracks , especially when the last save is loaded , may sounds 
   overlapping for a period. We have tracked the issue and release the fix it in the update.

- Out of stamina breath may keep playing when you exit to main menu. 
   We are releasing the fix in the update.

-  Further general optimizations of the loadings and performances will be applied constanstly in all the 
    updates.

-  We will keep this list updated whetever we find any other problem.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Known issues to fix in the next updates:

-  Some Users may experience a randomic crash or this could never manifest during the gameplay, We 
    have partially tracked the problem but since this is something strictly related to the cryengine 
    rendering code we will need some time to debug and collect crash logs from a wide range of PC's. 
    This task may take long time, we will update as soon we have news.

-   Switching trought different graphic settings specs (low, medium, high, very high) , especially when 
    you jump from low to high / very high can take up to a minute for reloading textures / objects. We 
    are looking to speed up this task into the internal code and as well will take some time. We highly 
    recommend to switch the specs in the game menu and not during gameplay and switch it gradually 
    for now.


Thank you : )

- Room 54 dev team

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0 is live
notes.notes:
Hotfix 1.0 is now live : )

FIXED ISSUES:

When the player die from monster after loading the last save and jump back in game pressing the controller jump button ( A ) or the left mouse button it can reload to the main menu. 

The F2 Key was allowing the player to teleport to some preset locations


TENTATIVE FIX

Sometimes , especially when saving the game while the player is out of stamina the audio breath could keep playing even when you go back to main menu. Fast solution is to restart the game and load again your last save..
We have imp,emented a tentative fix but this may not totally solve the problem, we are aware how to fix completely but require some extra time, will be 100% fixed in the next hotfix :)

As posted in the previous patch announce we have implemented some light fixes and modificated some UI to be more user-friendly giving the player some extra tips on how to use some keys or complete objectives.

We have slightly reduced the monster run speed to better balance the chasing

Thank you everyone for your patience and your feeback again, we wil keep monitoring the situation.

- Room 54 Dev team

notes.title: Hotfix planned for tomorrow
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! We are starting collecting your feedbacks from the game and we are trying to reproduce the most common issues reported to get an hotfix asap.

Know issues:

When the player die from monster after loading the last save and jump back in game pressing the controller jump button ( A ) or the  left mouse button it can reload to the main menu. We have identify the problem and deliver a fix tomorrow.

Sometimes , especially when saving the game while the player is out of stamina the audio breath could keep playing even when you go back to main menu. Fast solution is to restart the game and load again your last save. We have identify the issue and we should have hopefully a fix tomorrow.

The F2 Key allow the player to teleport to some preset locations, we have identify the issue and we will as well deliver the fix with the patch tomorrow.
(if you cheat, you are a bad person!!, don't use f2 key!) :D

Along with the hotfix we will update some other important things to improve the overall gameplay.

Thank you for those precious feedbacks!

- Room 54 dev team.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Room 54 Development Update
notes.notes: [b]Hi Dear Community, We know we've been "Offline" and give no news during this last months, in this news we want to talk to everyone is waiting the game and the demo and all of you that supported us, we are going to heavily modificate the initial setup and story of project of the game to a new one , as you know we are a very small startup team at our first game, during the development we see that our resources was very limited in order to create the project we wanted, we had to cut and move the project to another path, the game will remain a survival horror game of course but we will cut off some mechanics that will take too much for the implementation, we will inform you soon with updates and we will modify the steam description of the project so you can understand what we are doing and in the end we are pretty sure you will be happy with results, Thank you for your patience!  :) [/b]
